what: P2.6 root-cause proof — the browser CSSOM parse of each sheet's EXACT served bytes (fetch /src/styles/<file>?direct → new CSSStyleSheet().replaceSync() → recursive rule count), main :5173 vs the r325/ink-app worktree :5211
rootCause: Both dead sheets' banner comments spelled the motion token families as «--t-*/--motion-*» — the */ inside the token names CLOSED the banner early; the parser then consumed the whole @layer pages { … } block as one bogus qualified rule. Chromium parsed 0 rules for r305-student-schedule.css and r305-student-supplemental.css on main — every dark-theme re-derivation in those sheets (results-summary band inks, r305a-strip stat labels, r305u-fact labels, calendar/matrix anatomy) has been dead since r305. The r321 c1 WP-C0 sweep fixed the same disease in r305-student + training but missed these two siblings. Fixed in this branch by spelling the families out («the --t-* and --motion-* tokens»).
